scripts.review: Original implementation reviewed: exact JSON endpoints; pass-through on unknown shapes/errors; no external requests, storage, logging, authentication or payment edits. Synthetic fixtures only; iOS not verified.

Original implementation reviewed 2026-10-22: exact api.weibo.cn/2/ paths listed in data/weibo.json. Removes only entries the API marks as ads or promotions (mblogtypename 广告/热推, promotion objects, ad flags, ad item ids, wide banner card types 118/247) and recommendation modules: named trend cards and non-post modules whose wording is a recommendation (推荐优质博主, 可能感兴趣, 推荐关注, 为你推荐); posts, groups holding posts and groups holding a profile header are never matched by wording. In the owner's own following list (containers 231093…) it removes people the API marks as not followed (following false), recommendation headings, and recommendation-worded sections that contain nobody the owner follows. On the 我 page it removes modules and entries by visible name (钱包, 任务, AI伴聊, 活动, 红包, 会员, 商城, 游戏, 直播 and similar) plus known event/task ids; 相册, 赞/收藏, 草稿箱, 设置 and unknown modules stay. Post pages lose related-recommendation, product-placement and follow blocks, recommendation groups and the share card (other cards only when marked as ads); comment and repost areas lose ad and recommended entries; hot-search rows stay unless promoted. API errors, non-JSON, unknown shapes and other paths pass unchanged. No network, storage, notifications or logs. Synthetic fixtures only; iOS not verified.

archives.review: Original implementation reviewed: exact JSON endpoints for Bilibili, Zhihu and Weibo feeds; Weibo removes only posts labelled 广告/热推, promotion.type "ad", recommend_video_card groups and the ad/advertises arrays; pass-through on unknown shapes/errors (code / error_code / errno); no external requests, storage, logging, authentication or payment edits. Synthetic fixtures only; iOS not verified. Withdrawn 2026-10-22: after Weibo API decryption was added, Weibo profile and post pages stopped opening on the device; kept for modules cached in between.

Original implementation reviewed: exact JSON endpoints (Bilibili feed and splash, Zhihu recommend, WeChat article ad call mp.weixin.qq.com/mp/getappmsgad). WeChat: deletes only keys containing "advertisement", at most six levels deep, so read counts, likes, comments and other fields stay; it is the only route parsed without a JSON content type, and non-JSON still passes. Pass-through on unknown shapes/errors; no external requests, storage, logging, authentication or payment edits. Synthetic fixtures only; iOS not verified. Superseded 2026-10-23 when the WeChat route moved to its own module (wechat.js); kept for modules cached in between.

Original implementation reviewed 2026-10-23 against four public article pages (3.5-4.2 MB) and their page code. Article pages (https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/ and /s?, text/html only, at most 5 MiB, only when the head tag sits in the first 8 KB and the page carries the transfer table or the js_article container): inserts one style element right after <head> that hides the ad slots (.mpda_bottom_container, .iframe_ad_container, .comment-ad-container, mpcpc, mp-sponsor-ad, mp-common-cpsad, #js_top_ad_area, and comment rows holding a comment ad), and deletes the entries whose scope is mmbizwap_cgi_appmsgad from window.__ajaxTransferConfig, only when that statement keeps its plain shape afterwards; the rest of the page stays byte-identical, and a page already carrying the style is left alone. Ad call (/mp/getappmsgad, JSON object, at most 1 MiB, base_resp.ret 0 or absent): deletes keys containing "advertisement", at most six levels deep. Everything else passes unchanged. No network, storage, notifications or logs. Tests use synthetic pages built on the structure of those public pages, and synthetic replies; the four saved pages were also run by hand (the rest stayed byte-identical, about 5 ms each). iOS not verified. Retired 2026-10-23 with the WeChat module (the owner saw little effect on the device); kept so a module still cached on a phone keeps loading until it is deleted there.

third_party.review: Reviewed 2026-10-22 (minified bundle). Decodes YouTube protobuf responses on youtubei.googleapis.com and removes ad entries and the Premium upsell tab. The multi-client adapter defines $httpClient/$task.fetch but no code calls it, so the script makes no network requests. $persistentStore holds only its ad-detection cache and settings; the only notification is a local "script needs update" message. Request headers are read only to tell YouTube Music apart. Any byte change requires a new review.
